claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The project implements GraphRAG core functionality and represents knowledge as a graph structure.
claims.quote: **从零开始复现 GraphRAG**：完整实现了 GraphRAG 的核心功能，将知识表示为图结构

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The project combines GraphRAG with private-domain Deep Search to build an explainable, reasoning-capable Q&A system with multi-agent collaboration and knowledge graph augmentation.
claims.quote: 本项目聚焦于结合 **GraphRAG** 与 **私域 Deep Search** 的方式，实现可解释、可推理的智能问答系统，同时结合多 Agent 协作与知识图谱增强，构建完整的 RAG 智能交互解决方案。

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: GraphRAG retrieval supports multiple modes: local search, global search, and hybrid search.
claims.quote: **多级检索策略**：支持本地搜索、全局搜索、混合搜索等多种模式

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The project provides an evaluation system with more than 20 evaluation metrics to measure system performance comprehensively.
claims.quote: **完整评估系统**：提供 20+ 种评估指标，全方位衡量系统性能

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: LLM-driven entity and relation extraction uses large language models to identify entities and relations from text.
claims.quote: **LLM 驱动的实体关系提取**：利用大语言模型从文本中识别实体与关系

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: Entity disambiguation maps mentions to canonical entities using string recall, vector reranking, and NIL detection.
claims.quote: **实体消歧（Entity Disambiguation）**：使用字符串召回、向量重排和NIL检测将mention映射到规范实体

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: Entity alignment detects and resolves conflicts under the same canonical entity while preserving all relation information.
claims.quote: **实体对齐（Entity Alignment）**：智能检测和解决同一canonical实体下的冲突，保留所有关系信息

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The system supports dynamic incremental construction of the knowledge graph with intelligent deduplication.
claims.quote: **增量更新机制**：支持知识图谱的动态增量构建与智能去重
